endpointRule: Consume only VERIFIED or explicitly DEGRADED endpoints according to the manifest. Product APIs marked PENDING or UNAVAILABLE are not callable and must surface their exact classification rather than Offline.
prohibitions: do not build Product Session or device proof
do not create a second DApp SDK
do not hard-code Gateway or RPC
do not put localhost in a release
do not substitute Web success for installed-platform proof
do not classify Product Session failure as whole-app Offline
